name: Yuvomi
description: One private home for tasks, calendar, budget, meals and everything else that runs a household

paths.name: Data
paths.description: The database with all your household's data, and its two keys (.session_secret and .db_encryption_key, made on first start). Back up the whole folder: without .db_encryption_key the database can't be opened.

paths.name: Backups
paths.description: Scheduled and manual backups. They need the same database key to restore.

paths.name: Modules
paths.description: Optional drop-in modules from other people (see MODULES.md upstream).

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: Yuvomi web app, published on host as 6161

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.
